title: Keep the practice organized in noctune — web
tagline: Find any visit, and share the work.

headline: Start with
today.
scenes.narration: This video covers finding your way around a busy practice. The dashboard shows today's encounters. Filter to Unsigned to see notes that still need your review, and step through the days with the arrows.

headline: Every patient,
every visit.
scenes.narration: Patients lists everyone in the practice. Filter to Recent, or search by name. Open a patient to see their trends and Encounter History, with every past visit one click away.

headline: History beside
the note.
scenes.narration: While you review an encounter, open Past Encounters to check earlier visits, and the note stays open. Search those visits for a finding, such as the patient's weight.

headline: Search
everything.
scenes.narration: Press Command K to search encounters, patients, and messages at once. Type a symptom or a detail, and pick the visit you need.

headline: Bring in
your team.
scenes.narration: On the Practice page, owners and admins see active members and their roles, and pending invitations. Choose Invite member, enter an email, and pick a role.

headline: Share the
follow-up.
scenes.narration: In a practice, client messages land in a shared inbox. Filter to Unassigned, then assign a thread to a teammate, so everyone knows who's answering.
